children: AstraZeneca PLC (LSE:AZN) bolstered its oncology franchise with approvals for ZEGFROVY and an oral breast cancer pill, positive Phase III and China data for Tagrisso plus Orpathys, and an accepted first‑line sNDA, while adding securities to trade and appointing Wan Ling Martello to its board.
: AstraZeneca (AZN) licensed ZEGFROVY (sunvozertinib) from Dizal; drug is approved in US and China for EGFR exon 20 NSCLC, FDA accepted a first‑line supplemental NDA with Phase III data and BTDs.
: AstraZeneca (AZN) reported Chinese late-stage trial data: Tagrisso plus Orpathys significantly improved progression-free survival as first-line treatment for a specific lung cancer subtype.
AZN Wins FDA Approval For Oral Breast Cancer Pill
: AstraZeneca PLC (AZN) won FDA approval for its oral breast cancer pill despite a prior advisory committee vote against it, a key regulatory milestone for the company’s oncology portfolio.
Wan Ling Martello Appointed Non-Executive Director
: AstraZeneca (AZN) appointed Wan Ling Martello as Non-Executive Director and Audit Committee member effective Sept 1, 2026. Martello is BayPine cofounder and former Nestlé global CFO.
AZN Adds Securities To Trading Under POATRs
: AstraZeneca PLC (AZN) added further securities to trading on Sept 1, 2026 under POATRs PRM 1.6.4R; the notice confirms admission of additional securities and lists company contact details.
